literal: Do not begin any action, do not underestimate (the enemy) completely, except after having found the suitable place.
translation: Do not embark on any undertaking, nor underestimate your opponent, until you have identified a suitable place to act.
modern: பொருத்தமான இடத்தைக் கண்டறிவதற்கு முன், எந்தச் செயலையும் தொடங்கக் கூடாது; பகைவரை எளியவர் என்று இகழவும் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location before taking action. The author advises against two critical errors: starting an endeavor prematurely (தொடங்கற்க) and underestimating the opposition (எள்ளற்க). Both of these cautions must be observed until a strategic, advantageous place (இடம்) has been thoroughly identified. The word 'முற்றும்' emphasizes that one should not dismiss any aspect of the enemy's strength until the terrain is in one's favor.
